description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the "Number of tokens" and the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" for two different configurations, denoted in the legend as "MATTER (ours)" and "w/o material information." The x-axis represents the Number of tokens on a linear scale, with data points ranging from 0.5 to 1.5 and numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2 from 0.6 to 1.4. The y-axis represents the Macro-F1 Score (%) on a linear scale, with visible tick marks ranging from 48 to 56 at intervals of 2. The "MATTER (ours)" configuration is represented by a solid pink line with solid circular markers and a corresponding shaded variance band. This line begins at an x-value of 0.5 with a y-value of approximately 55.1, dips slightly to 54.3 at x=0.7, and then rises to its peak of approximately 57.9 at x=1.0. It then declines to 52.6 at x=1.3, briefly rises to 53.5 at x=1.4, and drops to end at approximately 50.9 at x=1.5. The "w/o material information" configuration is depicted by a solid purple line with solid circular markers and a shaded variance band. This line starts at x=0.5 with a y-value of approximately 52.5, rises to a peak of 54.1 at x=0.7, and then exhibits a gradual, steady decline across several data points to reach 51.7 at x=1.3. It then rises to 53.3 at x=1.4 before experiencing a sharp drop to end at approximately 47.9 at x=1.5.
